expected_results: A live-position read failure returns a reason; portfolio_fx maps account_not_demo -> positions_unsupported_live (STRUCTURAL), identity_refused -> read_refused (STRUCTURAL), endpoint_unavailable/config_missing -> endpoint_unavailable (STRUCTURAL), bridge_unreachable/read_timeout_budget -> stale_observation (TRANSIENT); an UNRECOGNISED reason defaults to TRANSIENT (never over-claims permanence).

open_positions records per-account unavailable_reason/unavailable_category/structural; the open-trades endpoint and build_summary expose unavailable_accounts [{account_id, reason, reason_category, structural}] + accounts_total/included/unavailable/structurally_unavailable. A legacy fetcher returning None is still a transient stale read (back-compat).

The OpenTradesPanel renders a structural exclusion as 'live positions not available for live accounts' (never 'reconnecting'/'temporarily'), a transient one as 'temporarily unavailable', both when mixed, and the plain legacy wording when the payload omits reasons.

The summary names the daily day window (broker_server_calendar_day) and the USD-eligible included/excluded account split; the realized figure is unchanged (closed-today net, deposits/withdrawals excluded, non-USD/mixed withheld, never a measured 0).

The equity-curve frontend discloses 'Partial coverage · latest N of M accounts' when any bucket is PARTIAL (present<total), so a varying-subset curve is not read as a whole-portfolio line; BUILDING stays distinct; no fabricated/forward-filled points.
No migration, no model, no feature flag, no production mutation; tenant isolation + null-never-zero invariants preserved; Copy Trading untouched; no PII.
actual_results: portfolio_fx.py: NEW POSITIONS_UNSUPPORTED_LIVE + ENDPOINT_UNAVAILABLE categories, _POSITION_REASON_CATEGORY map, STRUCTURAL_CATEGORIES set, position_reason_category() + is_structural() (single source of truth). views_trade_history.py: _fetch_mt5_open_positions returns a list on success or {'unavailable': True, 'reason': <code>} on each failure mode (config_missing/endpoint_unavailable/identity_refused/bridge_unreachable/account_not_demo). portfolio.py: open_positions interprets list|reason-dict|None, records per-account structural reason; NEW unavailable_accounts() helper; portfolio_open_pl carries the specific reason; build_summary adds unavailable_accounts + daily window/included/excluded counts + per-account position_structural. views_portfolio.py: open-trades payload carries unavailable_accounts + coverage counts.

Frontend: types/portfolio.ts adds UnavailableAccount + ExclusionReason values + EquityCurve types + the new payload fields. OpenTradesPanel.tsx renders structural vs transient wording (JA + EN). dashboard/page.tsx consumes per-point equity-curve coverage and shows a partial-coverage disclosure.

Tests: analytics suite Ran 272 OK (incl. 15 new backend tests across 6 classes); OpenTradesPanel.test.tsx 24 OK (incl. 4 new ADR-0100 cases); makemigrations --check clean; system check clean; next build OK; eslint clean on changed files.

Adversarial review (2 independent reviewers, distinct lenses): correctness/tenancy reviewer found 3 MEDIUM (0 HIGH/CRITICAL) — ALL fixed with regression tests: (1+2) the positions fetcher echoed the raw bridge error string verbatim as the reason code, which could leak an owner-scoped identifier AND collide with a structural reason key (over-claim) -> now only account_not_demo / positions_refused are emitted (bridge free text never echoed); (3) the daily included/excluded counts were computed blindly from the non-USD partition, contradicting the ADR-0066 single-currency conversion and the withheld-figure case -> now derived from the figure daily_realized_pnl actually produced. presentation/regression reviewer: NONE FOUND (false-reconnecting, equity-curve mislead, layout stability, i18n, type-degradation, count-consistency all cleared with evidence).

Diff scope: 8 code/test files changed (5 backend analytics + 3 frontend) + NEW OpenTradesPanel reason tests (in the existing file) + NEW ADR-0100 + this manifest. No migration, no model, no metrics fabrication, no config, no secret.
